name: Daud Khan Karrani
role: Last major Afghan ruler defeated at Rajmahal
contribution: His defeat in 1576 ended the Karrani line and opened the next phase of Mughal-Bengal conflict in which Baro-Bhuyans resistance emerged.
context: He ruled at the terminal phase of Afghan authority in Bengal before Mughal consolidation campaigns.
impact: His fall marks the strategic starting point for the post-sultanate resistance landscape.
highlight: Rajmahal's defeated ruler whose fall triggered a new resistance era.
